alerts.title: Temperature above safe band
alerts.description: Cargo temperature held at 16.2 °C for 38 minutes against a 15.0 °C ceiling for tomato loads.
alerts.recommendedAction: Lower the reefer set point by 1 °C and verify airflow around the rear pallets.

alerts.title: Spoilage probability above threshold
alerts.description: Model v2.4.1 scored 0.81 spoilage probability on arrival for this load.
alerts.recommendedAction: Schedule a pre-arrival quality inspection and notify the consignee of the projected grade.

alerts.title: Humidity below optimal band
alerts.description: Relative humidity dropped to 74% against an 85% floor for tomato loads.
alerts.recommendedAction: Check door seals and humidifier output; raise humidity toward the 85% floor.

alerts.title: Rising spoilage risk trend
alerts.description: Risk score increased from 0.38 to 0.58 over the last four hours.
alerts.recommendedAction: Increase telemetry sampling to 2-minute intervals until the risk trend flattens.

alerts.title: Logger reporting intermittently
alerts.description: Rear bay logger missed 3 consecutive telemetry windows.
alerts.recommendedAction: Power-cycle the logger at the next checkpoint and confirm it rejoins the mesh.

alerts.title: Door opened outside geofence
alerts.description: Cargo door registered open for 4 minutes at an unscheduled stop.
alerts.recommendedAction: Restrict door openings to scheduled stops within geofenced hubs.

alerts.title: ETA slipped beyond tolerance
alerts.description: Traffic delay on NH-44 pushed arrival 2h 15m past the committed window.
alerts.recommendedAction: Inform the receiving dock and re-slot the unloading appointment.

alerts.title: Pre-cooling completed
alerts.description: Container reached 2.0 °C before loading, within the 30-minute target.

alerts.title: Temperature spike during transfer
alerts.description: Brief 18.4 °C spike recorded during the cross-dock transfer window.
alerts.recommendedAction: Review cross-dock handling time and pre-cool the staging bay before transfers.

alerts.title: Ethylene concentration climbing
alerts.description: Ethylene at 2.7 ppm against a 2.5 ppm ceiling for banana loads.
alerts.recommendedAction: Verify ethylene scrubber media life and increase ventilation around the load.

alerts.title: Battery below 20%
alerts.description: Front bay logger battery at 18%; replace before the next dispatch.
alerts.recommendedAction: Replace the logger battery before the next dispatch.

alerts.title: Route deviation detected
alerts.description: Vehicle left the planned corridor for 11 km near Hosur.
